sources.ref: Owner + PhD student pilot debrief 2026-10-09: natural-language reinforcement of the time-pressure manipulation

notes: Two fixed team-chat lines per arm, after the check-in (active 60): the first at active 75 (15 s after the task resumes), the reply at active 83.
Speaker order is a per-session fair coin (seat_order fair_coin_per_session): 'first' is the drawn seat, 'second' the other seat, so remark speaker is balanced across JT/PM.

Deterministic bound copy delivered identically in the AI and scripted teammate builds; it bypasses generation, so the generated-output gate (urgency/voice_format/condition_leak) does not apply. Wording is verbatim from the owner, including punctuation and casing.
